plates.prompt: Orbit the orange sphere robot (ONE continuous matte orange body, cream oval eyes with pupils, tiny antenna with glowing tip, soft underside glow, NO legs, NO white chest disc) approaches Jupiter filling most of the sky — storm bands clearly readable. Continuous cinematic approach. Soft whoosh SFX only — no speech.
Orbit flies beside Jupiter's rolling storm bands — cream-orange and white weather like a world that could swallow Earths. Continuous lateral flyby along the belts. Soft whoosh SFX — no speech.
Beside giant Jupiter, Orbit turns toward small bright cracked-white Europa. Ice moon grows larger; dark linea scars become visible. Continuous approach to Europa. Soft whoosh SFX — no speech.
Orbit drifts closer over Europa's frozen ocean shell — cream eyes wide. Bright cracked ice fills the frame; Jupiter huge behind. Continuous gentle approach. Soft ice-whoosh SFX — no speech.
Orbit skims low reading Europa's long dark linea scars — fingerprints in the cold like something moved underneath the ice. Continuous low skim along a crack. Soft ice-whoosh SFX — no speech.
Orbit hovers at a deep ice fracture — sense of dark pressed liquid ocean unseen below the translucent blue-white frozen lid. Continuous push toward depth under ice. Soft deep ambient SFX — no speech.
Orbit tips into a Europa ice crack — antenna glowing — journey through the frozen lid toward whatever waits below. Continuous descent into blue-white ice canyon. Soft descent whoosh SFX — no speech.
